Subject: Pilot initiation — technical deep dive & prompt pass-off

Hi Alyssa / Rajesh —

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier today. Quick recap and a proposal for next steps so we can lock the pilot kickoff:

What we covered
- Primary goals: automate triage suggestions for support tickets, reduce avg. time-to-first-suggestion, maintain >85% precision on high-confidence results.
- Data shape: ~200k historical tickets, JSONL export with metadata; aims to test on subset first.
- Key success criteria: response latency under 150ms p50, precision on priority labels >=85%, and prompt throughput of ~30 reqs/sec sustained for load tests.

Proposed next meeting (technical deep dive / kickoff)
- Option A: Tue 21 Sep 2026, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Option B: Wed 22 Sep 2026, 14:00–15:00 PT

Please confirm which slot works best and whether Rajesh or a backend engineer should join for API/ingest questions.

Prework we need before the deep dive
- A small sample of 15–25 representative tickets (anonymized) + 2–3 known failure cases you want the model to avoid.
- One-line owner/point-of-contact for data access and an estimated date for when a service account or S3 access can be arranged if needed.

I attached a short pilot charter draft (pilot-charter-v0.3.pdf) and a prompt template CSV to make the pass-off faster. If you prefer a different cadence or want a shorter agenda, tell me and we’ll adapt.

Next steps
- Confirm slot (A or B) and attendees
- Share prompt sample and the anonymized ticket export (or a shareable path) by EOD Tue so Karthik can do initial signal checks

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Priya Natarajan

Adding a bit of color from the SE side — happy to drive the technical deep dive and run through the prompt evaluation workshop. Quick ask to make the session actionable:

1) Please send a short prompt subset (15 examples) with expected outputs and 2 labeled failure cases. We’ll use that to demo prompt iterations live and to seed the evaluation harness.
2) If you have any high-level throughput expectations for scoring (qps / concurrent sessions) please call them out — helps me size recommended instance types for the trial.

High-level pilot structure (what we typically aim for)
- Week 0: technical deep dive, confirm dataset access, baseline prompts
- Week 1: focused prompt tuning + small-batch runs against sample set
- Week 2: run scorecard, latency/load validation, produce success readout + next-steps proposal

I attached the prompt template (sample-prompt-template.csv) — use the columns there (id, prompt_text, expected_label, note).

If Wed 22 14:00 PT is confirmed I’ll block 60–90 minutes and prepare a short slide deck and a live demo script.
